title: Restriction augmentation into total hypercover sections
statement: For a scheme X, a sheaf R of commutative rings and a simplicial object U in the slice over W of the small pro-etale site, define section rows and their signed coproduct total T as in [def-weil-pbc-proetale-hypercover-total]. Restriction I(W) to I(U_0), followed by the degree-zero extension isomorphism, defines a map I(W)[0] to the alternating section row. Its composite with the row differential is zero. For every coefficient complex E these restrictions, inserted into the (0,n) total summands, define a natural chain map alpha_E:E(W) to T(E). No hypercover or boundedness assumption is required. The construction uses actual sheaf restriction maps, not an existence choice.

source.place: Tag 09A2, restriction augmentation in the final paragraph of lemma-compute-cohomology

proof.text: Use restriction along U_0 to W, with its semilinear map regarded as R(W)-linear via the slice-section functor. The two restrictions to U_1 agree by the over-category commutativity equations, so their alternating difference vanishes.

Transport through extension by zero and use mkHomFromSingle to construct the row map. In each coefficient degree n insert it into the (0,n) summand of the signed total. The horizontal contribution is zero, the vertical sign at p=0 is 1, and restriction commutes with coefficient differentials. The same calculation for a coefficient map proves naturality.
